# Backend 11 retention review
Every field, question, body, lead, supplement and embedded question variant was read. Full per-leaf dispositions and per-block evidence are in JSON. Every ID, question order, source, anchor, link and image remains unchanged. The current network guide differs from preflight in its already-integrated cross-reference navigation and wording; current catalog selection is the guarded baseline.

- Recovery: all failure categories, RPO/RTO, log chain, force_recovery level 4+, evidence windows and unknown commit remain.
- WAL: LevelDB 1.23 versus custom 9-byte big-endian frame; 25/8 split, validBytes 9 at truncation18, 8MiB/4096 bounds, 400 random cases and four payload limits, CRC versus sequence/authentication, all failure windows retained. Added exactly-seven-byte LevelDB exception and removed empty run-command introductions.
- CDC/ETL: snapshot100/update101, business versus publish versions, full images versus delta, deletes, source/MQ/search visibility, v3/v5/v6 compensation, strict external versus gte, gc_deletes, independent RR snapshots, ten-million export, format and manifest conditions retained.
- Migration: 8×128 slots, floorMod and negative min int, ten ID route bits, consistent ring and virtual nodes, k/(N+k), all figures, cold/hot merge versions/tombstones/filter-before-dedup counterexample, O(R log U+U), 100 permutations and cross-DC rollback retained.
- JDBC/Spring: 2000/s×5ms=10 estimate, timeout semantics, CRUD authorization, afterCommit and outer REQUIRED transaction boundaries, DDD, ORM versus batching, Django5.2.0, IoT256/1000000/1–80/1e9 and CPython3.12.0 LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL retained. Explicitly distinguished in-memory checks from process-reopen file durability.
- Cache/Search: signed URLs and streamed revocation, Redis7.2 versus Search2.10.31/Redis7.4, hard dietary filters, exact vector field contracts retained.
- DSL: typed six-value nodes, empty AND, UTF8, 65536/32/1024/4096 bounds, decimal1.0, version migration retained without claiming runnable listing.
- Network: all 17 questions, wire/address numerical examples, checksum, Linux/RFC scope, three/four-way and simultaneous states, window/RTO/Reno formulas, 100Mbps bandwidth examples, five-node connection budget, DNS/TLS/HTTP/browser/Pod distinctions, every image and original source link retained.
- Network supplements: 36 program identities (14/22), separate directories and all runtime/security constraints preserved; frame state/EOF/deadline, permit generation, 32-client/256-byte/4096-byte/15-second poll limits remain. Missing listing headings and commands become explicit model contracts.
